title: job.unblocked
description: The blocking flag came down and the job can move again. Parity with flowpilot's EventKind.UNBLOCKED. The fall of the flag is the fact; `reason` is what a person adds to it when they are the one lowering it.

reason.description: Why the flag came down, in free text, when a person is the one lowering it (t339). Optional, unlike job.blocked.reason: the control plane's own unblock-on-answer states none — the answer is already the fact — and demanding one there would be inventing a sentence nobody said.
examples: three weeks of real trades back this rule; releasing the promotion
